controls.RESISTANCE_IN_A_WIRE/a11y.formulaNode.ac: Resistance, R, is equal to resistivity, rho, times length, L, over area, A.
Size of letter R is { $rToRho } the size of letter rho, and { $rToLAndA } letter L and letter A.
Size of letter R is { $rToRho } the size of letter rho, { $rToL } letter L, and { $rToA } letter A.
Size of letter R is { $rToAll } the size of the letter rho, letter L, and letter A.

  [muchSmaller] much smaller than
  [slightlySmaller] slightly smaller than
  [comparable] comparable to
  [slightlyLarger] slightly larger than
  [muchLarger] much larger than
  *[muchMuchLarger] much much larger than

controls.RESISTANCE_IN_A_WIRE/a11y.resistanceInAW: There is a button to reset the sim.
Look for resistivity, length, and area sliders to play, or read on for details about equation and wire.
You find the Resistance equation, R equals rho times L over A, and a piece of wire. Sliders for resistivity, length, and area allow changes to the equation and the piece of wire.
